prompts.name: signalPrompt
prompts.prompt: Production game UI illustration, standalone wide landscape 3:2 buy-screen card for CYBER SKUNK, painted dimensional industrial style, restrained graphite #252D31, ivory #EFE5CF, aged brass #AD7840, pressure cyan #68C8C3. Strong crisp silhouette, selective shading, broad readable shapes, no tiny clutter, no neon overload. A solid dark graphite rounded rectangular metal plaque fills most canvas, small brass edge bevel, transparent outside its rounded corners. Object illustration in upper two thirds, large exceptionally legible condensed ivory uppercase title in lower third. No currency, prices, numbers, multipliers, odds, subtitle, buttons, extra lettering, characters, skunks, faces or tails. Intended export 720x480. Title exactly "SIGNAL BOOST". Main illustration: a single brass radio antenna mast on a compact graphite signal transmitter with three restrained cyan broadcast arcs above it, a small amber status lamp. Symmetric, confident mechanical silhouette. Leave generous side margins. Actual shippable card asset, not a screenshot or mockup.
